# @apvee/spfx-react-toolkit

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

> React controls, hooks, providers, helpers and services for SharePoint Framework (SPFx), with Fluent UI 9 and Property Pane pickers.

Version: 3.0.0

## API reference

- [API catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/INDEX.md): Public symbols and supported imports.
- [accordion-group](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/accordion-group.md): Related optional details composed as Fluent disclosures inside a native Card.
- [auto-skeleton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/auto-skeleton.md): Geometry-derived loading placeholders over mounted, bounded HTML content.
- [content-card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/content-card.md): Titled content and explicit caller actions composed with native Fluent Card interaction.
- [content-slot.types.internal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/content-slot.types.internal.md): Named-region content with a primary native `Tag` and one documented `Alternative`. `Owned` excludes outer-control attributes. Like ContentSlot, accepts shorthand or props with static/rendered children; callback props/ref must be forwarded and absence uses undefined/booleans (plus Fluent legacy null). The consumer chooses the alternative via `as`. Only use the alternatives promised by the owning public control; no arbitrary tag replacement. Associated declaration type only: consumers use the owning control's public props.
- [data-grid](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/data-grid.md): Controlled row presentation with suite-owned typed columns and native Fluent grid interactions.
- [description-list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/description-list.md): Read-only term/value metadata with native description-list semantics.
- [editable-text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/editable-text.md): Controlled single-block rich text with safe read rendering and lazy explicit editing.
- [entra-group-trim](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/entra-group-trim.md): Advisory content branches selected by current-user Entra membership or ownership.
- [file-folder-picker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/file-folder-picker.md): Hosted SharePoint and OneDrive file/folder selection with serializable metadata references.
- [form](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/form.md): Typed Form families, RHF value ownership and native Fluent bindings.
- [formatted-text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/formatted-text.md): Semantic text, toolkit typography and bounded inline Markdown.
- [pagination](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/pagination.md): Controlled offset, cursor and load-more requests with application-owned data.
- [pickers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/pickers.md): SharePoint metadata and principal discovery, scoped references and explicit selection.
- [preview-card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/preview-card.md): Native Fluent cards with generated images or caller-owned previews.
- [relative-time](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/relative-time.md): Localized relative instants with controlled/live clocks and full-date descriptions.
- [settings-group](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/settings-group.md): Visible settings rows with caller-owned controls and optional built-in Form naming.
- [sharepoint-group-trim](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/sharepoint-group-trim.md): Advisory content branches selected by direct SharePoint site-group membership.
- [sharepoint-permission-trim](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/sharepoint-permission-trim.md): Advisory content branches selected by effective SharePoint resource permissions.
- [stage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/stage.md): Explicit Dialog, Drawer and Popover surfaces sharing one caller-owned content structure.
- [state-message](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/state-message.md): Section states with caller copy, optional artwork and explicit actions.
- [web-part-shell](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/controls/web-part-shell.md): Actual SPFx web-part integration, persisted editable titles and inherited host presentation.
- [providers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/core/providers.md): Mount a native Application Customizer React surface with an isolated toolkit runtime.
- [types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/core/types.md): Host and provider metadata contracts.
- [api-permission-precheck](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/helpers/api-permission-precheck.md): Token-free delegated-scope diagnostics and configuration normalization. These helpers read supplied values without React context or token acquisition. Decoded claims and available scopes are diagnostic evidence; the target API still enforces authorization. No signature or issuer verification is performed.
- [container](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/helpers/container.md): Exclusive container-width categories from caller-supplied measurements.
- [graph-path](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/helpers/graph-path.md): Graph app-root and photo path builders without network operations.
- [page-context](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/helpers/page-context.md): Snapshot mappings for supplied SPFx user, site, list, regional and environment metadata. Each helper requires a real PageContext and returns a fresh, unfrozen object. Readonly is a TypeScript constraint; locale timeZone deliberately retains the host reference. No React provider, asynchronous host detection or input validation is added. Errors from malformed required fields/GUID conversion propagate. Optional output properties may be present with undefined values.
- [permission](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/helpers/permission.md): Local checks against supplied SharePoint permission snapshots.
- [storage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/helpers/storage.md): Storage-name prefixes scoped to a supplied SPFx instance ID.
- [styles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/helpers/styles.md): Immutable CSS hover, active and focus-visible scopes for base descriptors. States cannot nest or contain class strings. Focus-visible color changes do not create a focus outline; retain an accessible native/control indicator.
- [tenant-value](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/helpers/tenant-value.md): Historical tenant-value serialization and OData string-literal escaping.
- [theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/helpers/theme.md): Convert supplied host themes and choose shared Fluent Teams themes.
- [context](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/context.md): SPFx metadata access.
- [environment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/environment.md): Application SDK host acquisition complements URL and legacy environment metadata.
- [aad-http-client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/http-clients/aad-http-client.md): Entra resource clients initialize asynchronously and expose separate initialization errors.
- [aad-token-provider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/http-clients/aad-token-provider.md): Native token-provider acquisition does not request tokens automatically.
- [api-permission-precheck](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/http-clients/api-permission-precheck.md): Delegated-scope diagnostics do not grant access or replace server authorization.
- [graph-client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/http-clients/graph-client.md): SPFx Graph client initialization is separate from tracked request state.
- [http-client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/http-clients/http-client.md): Generic HTTP requests use the native host client with counted invocation state.
- [sharepoint-http-client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/http-clients/sharepoint-http-client.md): SharePoint REST calls use the host client; base URL state is caller-owned.
- [performance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/performance.md): Correlation and tenant identifiers are diagnostic metadata, not generated request headers.
- [permissions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/permissions.md): Scoped effective permissions use native current-web masks or selected-resource REST calls.
- [pnpjs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/pnpjs.md): Generic PnP operations expose explicit invocation and batching state.
- [properties](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/properties.md): WebPart read/edit flags follow the provider display mode.
- [react](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/react.md): Generic React callback utilities with no SPFx provider requirement.
- [configuration-store](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/storage/configuration-store.md): Explicit configuration scopes support site overrides over tenant defaults.
- [local-storage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/storage/local-storage.md): Browser storage uses an instance namespace and best-effort JSON persistence.
- [onedrive-app-data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/storage/onedrive-app-data.md): User/application JSON files have separate read/write state and explicit creation policy.
- [session-storage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/storage/session-storage.md): Browser storage uses an instance namespace and best-effort JSON persistence.
- [site-key-value-store](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/storage/site-key-value-store.md): The legacy collection-root list store is shared by all subsites.
- [tenant-key-value-store](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/storage/tenant-key-value-store.md): The legacy tenant list store exposes fallback reads and rejecting mutations.
- [tenant-property](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/storage/tenant-property.md): Tenant storage-entity reads retain data on same-identity reload failure.
- [theming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/theming.md): Container observation requires a WebPart host element and document ResizeObserver.
- [user-site](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/hooks/user-site.md): Legacy hub association can trigger a request to resolve the hub URL.
- [file-folder-picker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/property-pane/file-folder-picker.md): Native SPFx file/folder fields with hosted selection and caller-owned JSON persistence.
- [pickers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/property-pane/pickers.md): Native SPFx picker fields with JSON selection ownership and shared pane lifecycle.
- [api-permission-precheck](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/services/api-permission-precheck.md): Acquire one token per resource and return ordered delegated-scope diagnostics without React.
- [app-catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/services/app-catalog.md): Discover a tenant app catalog lazily and inspect its current-user site-administrator flag.
- [configuration-store](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/services/configuration-store.md): Compose whole-record site overrides over tenant defaults with explicit physical mutation targets.
- [onedrive-app-data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/services/onedrive-app-data.md): Read and replace user/application JSON files through Graph metadata and app-root content endpoints.
- [pnp-context](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/services/pnp-context.md): Resolve current/target web URLs and create SPFx-authenticated PnP clients with opt-in cache and headers.
- [pnp-list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/services/pnp-list.md): Query and mutate explicitly selected SharePoint lists, preserving settled partial-batch outcomes.
- [pnp-search](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/services/pnp-search.md): Run explicit SharePoint searches and suggestions with native server refinement tokens.
- [pnp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/services/pnp.md): Invoke caller work and execute PnP batches on an explicitly configured client.
- [site-key-value-store](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/services/site-key-value-store.md): Share collection settings in the root-web list with read-only probes and conditional mutations. Keys are forwarded unchanged; SharePoint field/unique-column comparison determines equality, while returned Title casing is preserved. URLs are trimmed and stripped of trailing slashes, not validated as collection/catalog addresses. Empty URLs reject before requests. Reads validate schema without enforcing or repairing uniqueness: get rejects duplicates, list preserves historical duplicate rows. Only the list existence probe's 404 is absence; field/item/page 404 and access failures reject. Services have no value cache, React provider dependency or disposal method.
- [tenant-key-value-store](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/services/tenant-key-value-store.md): Share tenant settings through a caller-selected app-catalog list with observed-ETag mutations. Keys are forwarded unchanged; SharePoint field/unique-column comparison determines equality, while returned Title casing is preserved. URLs are trimmed and stripped of trailing slashes, not validated as collection/catalog addresses. Empty URLs reject before requests. Reads validate schema without enforcing or repairing uniqueness: get rejects duplicates, list preserves historical duplicate rows. Only the list existence probe's 404 is absence; field/item/page 404 and access failures reject. Services have no value cache, React provider dependency or disposal method.
- [tenant-property](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/services/tenant-property.md): Read legacy StorageEntity values from a caller-selected tenant app catalog.
- [user-photo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/api/services/user-photo.md): Retrieve selected Microsoft Graph profile-photo bytes through a caller-owned client.

## Documentation

- [SPFx React Toolkit documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/INDEX.md): SPFx React Toolkit provides React controls, providers, hooks, typed styles, helpers and services for SharePoint Framework applications. It brings together access to SPFx context, component properties, HTTP clients, PnPjs, themes, permissions and storage. Host-specific providers keep runtime state scoped to each SPFx instance.

## getting-started

- [Choose a provider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/getting-started/choosing-a-provider.md): Choose a provider for the actual initialized SPFx instance, and bind its React tree to that host surface’s lifetime.
- [Install the toolkit and shared peers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/getting-started/installation.md): Install the toolkit in the consuming SPFx application and align its shared runtimes with the host. Declared peer ranges and the repository verification baseline are different compatibility claims.
- [Build a first SPFx web part](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/getting-started/quick-start.md): Mount a complete web part with WebPartShell, wire title metadata and Property Pane settings, then unmount its React tree when SPFx disposes the host.

## guides

- [Control presentation slots](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/control-slots.md): Customize named presentation regions with shorthand content or slot objects while preserving the control’s semantics, labels, refs and event wiring.
- [Own grid data and navigation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/data-grids.md): Create a typed column suite or render dynamic records, then own sorting, filtering, off-page selection and request state in the application.
- [Persist a single editable region](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/editing.md): Choose a permitted HTML block and formatting policy, then retain one saved content authority through controlled echoes, edit mode and recovery.
- [Build forms with explicit ownership](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/forms.md): Choose one form suite and validation owner, compose fields inside a native form, then await persistence before reset or dismissal. Records, drafts and date/time domains require deliberate application policies.
- [Compose helpers and services outside React](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/helpers-and-services.md): Use explicit inputs and initialized clients to compose transformations and I/O outside React. The caller owns authentication, request policy and service lifetime.
- [Choose and invoke an HTTP client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/http-clients.md): Choose the HTTP client for the target resource and distinguish initialization, invocation state, request failure and authorization.
- [Localization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/localization.md): Toolkit UI text uses native SPFx localized resources, separated by control/family. The package ships all 50 SharePoint UI cultures listed in [the locale fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/tests/fixtures/sharepoint-ui-locales.json): eight resources and 400 AMD files. Canonical JSON dictionaries are validated for exact keys, nonblank text, template parameters, plural categories and calendar arrays during the library build. Translations have structural and sampled semantic review; they are not a native-speaker certification for every culture.
- [Read host metadata and diagnose behavior](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/metadata-and-diagnostics.md): Use provider hooks for live host integration and explicit helpers for supplied PageContext snapshots. Distinguish UI culture, regional formatting, site correlation, measurement and asynchronous SDK metadata.
- [Package imports and tree shaking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/package-imports.md): Choose supported package entry points while preserving public aliases, shared runtime identities and explicit PnP feature registrations.
- [Plan permissions and API prechecks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/permissions.md): Choose a permission check for the protected resource and treat the result as advisory evidence before the server authorizes a request.
- [Select and persist SharePoint references](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/pickers.md): Choose a discovery source, keep complete saved identities distinct from their resolved display subset, and treat navigation, accepted scope and remote writes as separate decisions.
- [Choosing and composing React controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/react-controls.md): Compose controls around explicit state, native form ownership and host lifetimes. Choose presentation independently of persistence and verify real-host behavior separately.
- [Use stable callbacks and committed values](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/react-utilities.md): Keep callback identity stable after commit while reading current state, and distinguish render-time behavior from retained event callbacks.
- [Choose a storage scope](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/storage.md): Choose storage by lifetime, sharing and permissions, then define read, write and failure ownership.
- [Compose typed styles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/guides/styling.md): Compose typed descriptors inside React through the host renderer and theme, with deliberate precedence and browser verification.

## Optional

- [Develop and maintain SPFx React Toolkit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/development/INDEX.md): Use these procedures to work on the public library, its private SPFx sample, verification tools and documentation. Local tests and browser fixtures provide different evidence from an authenticated SharePoint run.
- [Validate the toolkit in SharePoint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/main/docs/development/sharepoint-validation/INDEX.md): Use this essential checklist for actual SPFx lifecycle, authentication, effective permissions, persistence and interaction. A procedure is not execution evidence: record each affected boundary as PASS, FAIL, NOT EXECUTED or BLOCKED, separately from local simulations and builds.
